references_note: Four user-uploaded images have no exposed local paths; provided directly from conversation to image_gen. Reference manifest records exact roles; do not misrepresent reconstructed images as originals.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete production anime CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET, landscape3:2 PNG, ideally1536x1024, opaque pale warm cream background. This is a design experiment for SASHA, the12-year-old protagonist of the grounded time-return story 'Кассеты' ('Помнишь, как будет'). He looks12 but remembers an adult life. Adapt the user's attached KILLUA references into a proposed new Sasha appearance. This user request explicitly authorizes similar face/hair aesthetics, the SAME layered clothing cut and ANIME drawing style. Do NOT use the old paper-collage medium.
INPUT IMAGES, in order: image1 user's multi-shot Killua screenshot collage, for hair, eyes and calm/daring mood; image2 user's dark close-up portrait, for angular eyelids and serious expression but NOT dark lighting; image3 user's full Killua turnaround sheet, the PRIMARY reference for body proportions, outfit cut and sheet views; image4 user's leaning full-body Killua illustration, for loose shirt drape, youthful pose and expression, IGNORE its watermark/print logo entirely. Image5 is the OLD Sasha face sheet: NARRATIVE CONTEXT ONLY, for the thoughtful too-adult gaze. Do NOT copy its brown hair, clothes, collage texture or old exact identity; do not depict its other ages.
DRAWING STYLE: clean hand-drawn2D anime character design consistent with user's Killua screenshots, crisp thin charcoal-gray linework, flat readable local colors with restrained two-tone cel shading, clear expressive eyes and simple clothing folds. NO paper fibers, torn edges, craft texture, collage layers, watercolor, painterly rendering, photorealism,3D, airbrush glow or film effects.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY THREE intact FULL-BODY turnaround views of ONE SAME12-year-old boy across the LEFT70% of the canvas: FRONT, strict LEFT-FACING PROFILE and BACK; plus ONE LARGE head-and-shoulders PORTRAIT on the RIGHT30%, centered vertically. The three full bodies at equal scale, their feet on the same baseline and heads at the same height, figures occupy about85% canvas height. Six-ish-heads-tall slender preteen proportions like the reference, narrow youthful shoulders, thin limbs, natural child hands. Natural relaxed arms at sides, hands not hidden in pockets. No T-pose or action scene. All views and portrait depict EXACTLY THE SAME person, same haircut, eyes and outfit. Maintain complete hair, hands and boots within canvas, with4-5% margin. Generous separation between intact figures; no overlapping silhouettes or cut-off joints.
OUTFIT CUT: reference's roomy short-sleeve T-shirt over fitted long-sleeved high-neck/turtleneck shirt; loose knee-length shorts; soft high-top ankle boots with folded cuffs and rounded contrasting toe caps/soles. This specific layered cut can match reference closely. No jewelry, bag, weapon, modern brands or printed graphics.
PALETTE: muted warm-cream #F1E6CF, faded teal #5E8C8A, olive #7A7F3F, warm gray #A59B8C, subtle mustard #D9A441. Hair may be light ash/silver with warm neutral shadows. Preserve naturally warm light skin, make silhouette contrast with the pale background. Avoid original bright purple costume, neon saturated blues and red accents.
STORY TONE: quiet intelligent preteen, observant gaze, composed confidence with a little mischief, suitable for Russian2000s family, school and bedroom scenes. Child, not a muscular adult or toddler. No electricity, fantasy powers, combat, blood, bruises, scars, darkness, speed lines or supernatural imagery.
TEXT: NONE. No letters, labels, numbers, view names, signature, logo or watermark. No color swatch circles, arrows, borders or decorative design layout. Only the3 full bodies and1 portrait on a clean plain light background.
VARIANT A — CLOSE TO KILLUA REFERENCE: compact softly angular youthful face, small pointed chin and straight little nose; LARGE clear GRAY-TEAL eyes with confident slightly lifted outer corners, relaxed brows, very subtle knowing half-smile in portrait. SILVER-ASH LIGHT HAIR, full rounded starburst mass of irregular sharp tufts around head, layered short bangs close to the user's Killua reference. Not a smooth bowl cut; preserve this compact starburst silhouette from front/profile/back. Naturally light warm skin, ears visible in profile.
EXACT A COSTUME COLORS: loose CREAM T-shirt; DEEP MUTED TEAL high-neck fitted underlayer with long sleeves fully visible from elbows to wrists; WARM GRAY knee-length shorts; muted OLIVE-GRAY cuffed high-top boots with CREAM rounded toe caps/soles and tiny mustard fastenings. Shorts lengths and boot cuff heights identical in all views. Keep the portrait clothing identical to the full bodies. The calm knowing eyes carry the 'adult memories' quality, without adult stubble or wrinkles.
